I also told him the date hasn't been checked against a contract, because I can't see a Brackenwater contract in the shared files.

While reading the channel I found a problem: my end-of-task summary from the last request was posted into #north-team as its own message (ts `1791986400.000125`). It included the gbrain setup notice and the `gbrain doctor` command. Nothing in it is confidential, but it's internal noise the team didn't need. I can't delete messages, so someone with admin rights would need to remove it if you want it gone.
